note: Triennial election of the Belfast rural district councillors. The whole council was returned unopposed at the nominations of 13 May 1927, so there was no poll; the round is filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
